setup: for p in telegram discord buzz t3 voice; do d=external_plugins/$p; if [ -f $d/package.json ]; then rm -f $d/bun.lock && bun install --cwd $d --silent || exit 1; fi; done
verify: jq -e '.name != "hex" or ([.plugins[].name] | contains(["telegram", "discord", "buzz", "t3", "voice"]))' .claude-plugin/marketplace.json >/dev/null && out=$(mktemp -d) && for f in hub/serve.ts external_plugins/buzz/provider.ts external_plugins/telegram/bot.ts external_plugins/discord/bot.ts external_plugins/buzz/bot.ts external_plugins/t3/bot.ts external_plugins/voice/bot.ts; do if [ -f $f ]; then bun build --target bun --external ffmpeg-static $f --outdir $out/${f%.ts} >/dev/null || exit 1; fi; done && for p in telegram discord buzz t3 voice; do d=external_plugins/$p; if [ -f $d/bot.ts ]; then jq -e --arg p $p '.mcpServers[$p].type == "http"' $d/.mcp.json >/dev/null || exit 1; fi; done && for d in hub external_plugins/telegram external_plugins/discord external_plugins/buzz external_plugins/t3 external_plugins/voice; do if ls $d/*.test.ts >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun test ./$d || exit 1; fi; done
